title: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller $72.99 Delivered ($69.34 with NAB Card, RRP $99.95) @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)
body:
Deal: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller $72.99 Delivered ($69.34 with NAB Card, RRP $99.95) @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)

[skinnybutt1] Still use mine with NS2 and it has been rock solid, why would you go for NS2 pro for $40 more?
[cook99] So you can turn on the NS2 without getting up
[krayl] OMG can you? I have had Switch 2 and Pro controller 2 since launch and still turn it on via the console like a caveman.
[Swankenstein] Switch 2 Pro is the best controller I have ever used
[cook99] GameCube is the peak of human achievement
[JacobAU] As someone who has used both extensively, the gyro on the switch 2 version is much better (even though the og’s is really good on its own). One thing I felt is that it is slightly slimmer width wise so I actually so it can feel a tad more cramped in your hand, though a pretty minor issue.
Overall better responsiveness, better gyro, significantly better rumble/haptics. If you have a switch 2 it’s a no brainer.
And you get to wake it up with home button with switch 2 version only
[azngamer] Not mentioned in the thread - headphone jack and additional 2 bumper buttons is pretty awesome
[pjbargain15] FYI - This is NOT Switch 2 Pro Controller. It is S1 Pro Controller
[mathemagician] Would OW or Jb price beat or not since Amazon is online only?
EDIT: Google says yes to both. OW will also beat it by 5%.
[TightLikeThisx] I'm tempted to get one to shuck it for a 3DS battery.
[rxjb] This or 8bitdo Bluetooth for $50? I get its original oem….am looking for controllers for my kids switch
[scepticpsych] You can get them from aliexpress for around $30
[cobknob] Thought it was the switch 2 pro controller 😭 - a mirage
